item.text:
Integrity check passed: [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-09_08-06-10-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md) is present (599 lines), `audit/run_all.sh` reproduces everything, 15 artifacts are preserved under `work/audit/`, and `go vet ./...` is clean. `go build` also passes and the intentionally-aborting end-to-end test stays env-guarded.

**Final audit handoff**

Target: the supplied `github.com/hashicorp/raft` tree — byte-identical to upstream release `v1.7.3` (git hash `c0dc6a0b…`, equal to the brief's `source_identity`). So there is no injected mutation; nothing is reported as such, and all findings are genuine properties of the released code.

Concrete, reproducible defects — one localized class (RPC handlers feeding unvalidated peer bytes to panicking functions, with no `recover()` in the RPC main loop):

- **F1** — `InstallSnapshot.Configuration` invalid msgpack with `SnapshotVersion>0` → `installSnapshot`→`DecodeConfiguration` panics → node process crashes (reproduced directly and end-to-end). The sibling legacy `Peers` path handles the same malformed input gracefully. Remote, unauthenticated (no peer/membership check in `net_transport.go`; `checkRPCHeader` only checks a sender-chosen protocol version).
- **F2** — `AppendEntries` entry with an unrecognized `LogType` → `processLogs`→`prepareLog` `default` panic on the follower.
- **F3** — `AppendEntries` `LogConfiguration` entry with non-msgpack `Data` → `processConfigurationLogEntry`→`DecodeConfiguration` panic.

Supporting evidence: 7-case malformed-input battery with four graceful controls isolating the defect to exactly three call sites; documented upstream test-coverage gap explaining the green suite; suggested (unapplied) fix directions.

Negative/benign evidence: broad `-race` sweep (0 races/panics), randomized partition/heal + leadership-transfer consistency (no FSM divergence), crash/restart durability incl. snapshot restore, snapshot retention and config-change semantics, and analogous local/legacy decode paths — all clean.

Everything reproduces with `bash audit/run_all.sh`; executed observations are distinguished from source-based reasoning throughout.

Unresolved (external to this sandbox, §5): run the ~15 TCP/loopback test groups via the private-loopback `isolated_exec`, and byte-verify/run `fuzzy/` and `raft-compat/` once a reference or their dependencies are available. Within the granted permissions, this audit is complete.
